How Much Would a Wedding Like Nupur Sanon & Stebin Ben Cost in India?

August 07, 2026 • Viraaya Weddings Team

Who doesn’t love a good Bollywood wedding? In January of 2026, Nupur Sanon, sister of actor Kriti Sanon, shared the happy news of her engagement to longtime partner, singer Stebin Ben, declaring it to be “the easiest YES” she’s ever had to say. 

Their wedding took place in the glorious City of Lakes and Love. 

That’s Udaipur, of course. 

As we scroll through the star-studded guest list and like every single Instagram post, what stands out is the soft glam and romance. Every photograph is lit by candlelight and we can’t help but match the smiles of the happy couple. 

If their multi-ceremony love story has you dreaming a little, come along as we unravel the details (including what a celebrity wedding like this can cost in India) and help you imagine one of your own.

 

Where Did Nupur Sanon and Stebin Ben Get Married?

For their wedding celebrations, Nupur Sanon and Stebin Ben chose Raffles Udaipur, a venue that has hosted its fair share of grand celebrity weddings over the years. The festivities began with a haldi and chooda ceremony awash in saffron, turmeric and ochre tones, followed by the classic mehndi and sangeet celebrations. 

Then came the part we cannot stop thinking about. The couple chose to honour both their faiths through two wedding ceremonies, one Hindu and one Christian, both handled with care and honour.

A reception later took place at The St. Regis Mumbai, where the couple celebrated with friends from the film and music industries. 

 

How Much Does a Celebrity Wedding Cost in India?

Naturally, no official details have been shared about Nupur Sanon and Stebin Ben’s celebrity wedding cost. However, we can make an educated guess. 

For a destination wedding with around 200 guests, venue costs alone at premium properties in Udaipur can range from ₹60 lakh and ₹3 crore (costs go even higher during peak season, between October and February). The Stebin Ben and Nupur Sanon wedding sits comfortably in the upper bracket. A good amount of this is driven by the legacy of Raffles Udaipur's pricing model and the peak season.

However, you do not always need a celebrity wedding budget to have something comparable in the beautiful city of Udaipur. The city gives you a lot to work with.

 

Why Do Families Choose Udaipur for Weddings?

There is a reason Udaipur shows up in every serious conversation about destination wedding costs in India. The lakes, the Aravalli hills, the heritage palaces, the sheer visual drama of the place: it photographs beautifully and feels special to every guest who travels in for the weekend. There’s little doubt why Udaipur is frequently touted as the most romantic city in India. 

For couples in Indian metro cities, it is also very practical. Udaipur has direct flights from Mumbai, Delhi, and Ahmedabad. Chartered flights from Bengaluru and Hyderabad are common for larger guest lists. Years of luxury weddings have also shaped a seasoned ecosystem of vendors in Udaipur, including decorators, caterers and hospitality teams who know exactly how to bring even the most ambitious celebrations to life. 

Just like Nupur Sanon and Stebin Ben’s wedding, Udaipur's premier properties are designed to host complex, multi-ceremony celebrations across different spaces within the same hotel.

 

The Top Wedding Venues in Udaipur and What They Cost

If your wedding vision looks anything like what Nupur and Stebin pulled off, here is a straightforward guide to luxury wedding costs in India. The following prices are based on a 2-night and 3-day celebration and assume a full buyout of the venue.

 

1) Raffles Udaipur

The venue from the Sanon-Ben wedding. A private island on Udai Sagar Lake, accessible by boat. 137 rooms, multiple lawns and indoor venues, and that signature European-Rajasthani architecture. 

Estimated cost: ₹2.5 crore to ₹3 crore. 

 

2) Taj Aravali Resort and Spa

A stunning venue from the Taj legacy, this resort is modern and large-scale, pairing surprisingly well with Udaipur's heritage aesthetic. With 181 elegantly designed rooms, suites, and tents, Taj Aravali Resort & Spa offers a breathtaking setting for a hillside wedding in Udaipur.

Estimated cost: ₹1.8 crore to ₹2.5 crore.

 

3) Taj Lake Palace

A floating 18th-century white marble palace in the middle of Lake Pichola. Guests arrive by shikara, and the palace can host up to 200 guests outdoors. Intimate and unmistakably iconic. 

Estimated cost: ₹3 crore to ₹3.5 crore.

 

4) The Oberoi Udaivilas

Consistently among the best-reviewed luxury hotels in the world. Full lake views, private plunge pools and the elegance of a royal Mewari palace: the property is renowned for its privacy and breathtaking setting. Its 87 rooms and suites make it perfect for intimate wedding celebrations (larger events often accommodate guests across nearby luxury properties). 

Estimated cost: ₹3.5 crore to ₹4.5 crore.

 

5) The Leela Palace Udaipur

Five distinct venue spaces on the edge of the glittering Lake Pichola, including the dramatic outdoor Rangmanch courtyard. Often brought up in publications as India's leading wedding venue. 

Estimated cost: ₹2.5 crore to ₹3 crore.

 

6) Fairmont Udaipur Palace

Built specifically for grand Indian weddings. Mughal-inspired architecture, striking accents, large ballrooms and lush gardens that handle big guest lists beautifully. 

Estimated cost: ₹5 crore to ₹6.5 crore.

 

7) Jagmandir Island Palace

Managed by the Mewar royal family and sitting on its own island on Lake Pichola, this property is unlike any other. Often used for standalone functions like sangeet or cocktail evenings rather than full buyouts. 

Estimated cost: ₹1.5 crore and ₹3.5 crore.

 

Wedding planning pro tip: destination wedding costs in India hinge on a colourful spectrum of requirements. Guest count, room categories, number of functions, décor direction and food and beverage requirements all play a part. In cities like Udaipur especially, pricing can shift dramatically with the season and overall demand, so it’s always wise to treat estimates as flexible until the hotel confirms the final quote.

Frequently Asked Questions

Raffles Udaipur has already hosted several high-profile celebrity weddings, including those of Hardik Pandya and Natasa Stankovic, as well as P. V. Sindhu and Venkata Datta Sai.

The most affordable time to get married in Udaipur is usually during the off-season, between May and August. Venues and hotels often offer lower rates during these months due to the summer heat and monsoon season.

One of the most expensive weddings ever hosted in Udaipur was the November 2025 wedding of Netra Mantena and Vamsi Gadiraju. The multi-day celebrations took place across some of the city's most iconic heritage venues, including Jagmandir Island Palace, Taj Lake Palace and The Leela Palace. Guests enjoyed appearances from celebrities such as Jennifer Lopez, Ranveer Singh, Shahid Kapoor, Dia Mirza, Janhvi Kapoor, Jacqueline Fernandez and Nora Fatehi. While exact figures are unconfirmed, we estimate that the celebrations cost upwards of ₹75 to 90 crore, making it one of Udaipur's most lavish weddings to date.
